cooled_centre_armrest.decision: Imported only for the two Hybrid 155 configurations explicitly qualified by the brochure. No projection to Hybrid-G 150 or mild-hybrid Journey/Extreme configurations.

front_centre_armrest.decision: Imported only where the page-22 console rows explicitly include an armrest; other Journey/Extreme powertrains remain unobserved for this brochure source.

deferred.reason: The existing dictionary attribute represents only the luggage-compartment socket; no front-socket attribute was added.

deferred.item: USB-C front/rear distribution and total port count
deferred.reason: The current count attribute does not distinguish front and rear ports; only the directly represented rear USB-C presence was imported.
No exact active attribute contract exists; key count is not an equivalent representation.
The boolean digital-cluster attribute records presence only; size variants were retained in source notes and not forced into colour-specific attributes.
Later configurator records use 10-inch values; the brochure 10.1-inch wording is a historical source-specific discrepancy requiring a separate scalar-value import review.

deferred.item: Media Nav Live speaker upgrade and Arkamys 3D sound
deferred.reason: Standard speaker_count observations already represent the base grade state; the optional Expression upgrade requires richer system/option context and was not flattened.

deferred.item: EASY, PARKING, WINTER and WINTER PLUS packages
deferred.reason: Composite package identities and component applicability are not represented by one existing boolean attribute; no component states were inferred from package markers.
No exact vehicle-equipment attribute exists; these remain accessory/product-scope facts.

deferred.item: USB front ports, speaker system variants and service durations
deferred.reason: Only directly represented existing attributes were imported; numeric distribution and service-term semantics remain outside this batch.
